title: WP-VER-C: seven deterministic G08 controls in the canonical gate (badf-engineering-verification -> VALIDATED)
objective: Judge typed G08 objects against each other, the Work Package and the composition record: one PURE function check_g08_dossier(dossier, work_package, evidence, composition_record, record) -- no I/O, no git -- wired into validate_dossier only for G08 dossiers claiming PASS / PASS_WITH_CONDITIONS. C1 exact target (VER-I01: dossier source_revision + composition record's expected_content_tree / target_base_sha); C2 one composed identity (VER-I05); C3 independence and quorum by change class (VER-I04/I19: the author's execution or identity cannot review unless the single-collaborator deviation is carried as an OPEN condition; C2/C3 need a verification record with >=2 / >=3 distinct reviewers and runs and the mandatory lenses); C4 runtime credit when the WP declares verification_obligations.runtime_required (VER-I08); C5 per-artifact non-coverage unless comprehensive_coverage_permitted_for names the type (VER-I11); C6 review blockers resolved (VER-I12: OPEN MAJOR/CRITICAL refuses PASS, maps to a condition on PASS_WITH_CONDITIONS; review findings carried or withdrawn by the record); C7 composed-result authority (VER-I15: composed-tree-test never NOT_APPLICABLE). Every control fires only on declared fields; WP-2026-0010's generic dossier stays valid. Optional closed verification_obligations field added to work-package.schema.json additively.
business_value: VER-B could see a bare-PASS review; it could not see a review of one tree beside observations of another, an author reviewing itself, a C2 dossier with one ballot, a MAJOR finding passed over, or a composed observation declared not applicable. These controls make the G08 exit criteria -- review blockers resolved, composed result verified, non-coverage declared -- deterministic instead of narrative.
in_scope: scripts/badf_gate.py: check_g08_dossier (pure; C1..C7) + G08_QUORUM / G08_REQUIRED_LENSES / G08_OBSERVATIONS + _independent_reviewer_deviation_carried; wiring in validate_dossier for gate G08 and disposition PASS/PASS_WITH_CONDITIONS (resolves evidence objects, the composition record and the verification record; validate_verification_record runs on a JSON review artifact first)
schemas/work-package.schema.json: optional closed verification_obligations {runtime_required: boolean, comprehensive_coverage_permitted_for: [G08 types]} beside tdd_exception
